title: Mexican Taco Zesty Delight
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Mexican-inspired dish, perfect for anyone who loves tacos. This recipe combines the zesty flavors of taco seasoning with the crunch of pistachios.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of pistachio oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add zesty taco seasoning and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, black beans, and corn. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until heated through.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning filling onto tortillas.
Top with diced avocado, a sprinkle of pistachios, and a squeeze of lime juice.
